question.text: During DD on Chambal Opportunities Fund, the LP team asks about 'competing or outside interests' of the Investment Manager. Per Ch 12, which of the following is a legitimate LP concern?

answer.text: The Manager's employees taking paid vacation.
The Manager's use of external printing vendors for marketing collateral.
The Manager's payment of GST on management fees.

Other AIF interests, business obligations or outside ventures of the IM that compromise time devoted to the fund, external professional engagements where fees are charged to the fund, and board positions in investee companies that may create disclosure conflicts.

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 329-330 list legitimate competing/outside-interest concerns: other AIF or business obligations of the manager, time devoted to fund management, professional-service fees charged to the fund, and financing-deal or board-position conflicts in investee companies. The Trap: Options A, B and C describe operational items that are not competing or outside interests under the workbook's framework. Note: Each of the items in the correct option maps directly to the page 329-330 competing/outside-interest categories.
